super6.race: Support The Injured Jockeys Fund Handicap Hurdle
super6.comment: Fair placed form in maiden/novice hurdles last winter. Hasn't gone on over fences more recently, off the bridle before most when well held at Newcastle (2½m) last time. Hard to be confident back up in trip on return to hurdling.

super6.race: Happy 80th Birthday Pamela Hall Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Four-time hurdles winner. Jumped much better than usual when easily justifying support under Harry Cobden (1-1) at Uttoxeter (3m) in July. That form has worked out well, and he doesn't have much to find in his bid for a second chase success.

super6.race: BAR 1 Betting 'Safer Gambling Week' Rated Race
super6.comment: A fairly useful 7f winner in the UAE for Michael Costa. Changed hands for £100,000 but made a discouraging start for these connections when last of 17 in handicap (66/1) at the Curragh (7f, good to firm) on debut. Might be better suited by return to all-weather, at least.

super6.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
super6.comment: Ten Sovereigns colt wasn't given a hard time but shaped quite well amidst obvious greenness when fifth of 8 in maiden at Leopardstown (1m, good to firm, 100/1) on debut in August. Absent since but should still improve.

finals.race: Guaranteed Odds At David Lucas Bookmakers Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: €28,000 Tirwanako gelding who was successful on the second of his 2 starts in points and showed plenty to work on behind a good prospect over C&D on hurdling debut 6 weeks ago. Likely to improve.

finals.race: Racing To School Reaches 25 Years Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Modest maiden on the Flat didn't achieve very much on hurdles debut at Sedgefield earlier in the month. Wears first-time hood.

finals.race: Racing To School Reaches 25 Years Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Very little sign of ability on the Flat, so easy to oppose now hurdling.

finals.race: Jumps Look Better On Racing TV Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Displayed steady progress in 4 bumper runs, including an excellent fifth in Aintree Grade 2 in April. Fair form in pair of hurdle outings this autumn, the emphasis on speed possibly not ideal when fifth in a Newbury maiden (2m) 2 weeks ago. This test more suitable and he looks the one to beat.

finals.race: Jumps Look Better On Racing TV Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Lightly-raced winner in points who went off at single-figure odds but ultimately shaped like one for staying handicaps later on when sixth of 9 in maiden hurdle at Hexham (2½m, good to soft) 2 weeks ago. Sharp nature of this track probably not ideal given how he shaped then.

finals.race: Ascot Promoting Safer Gambling Week 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: In need of experience in a pair of bumpers but made a much better fist of things switched to hurdles, losing out narrowly for second time in 3 starts at Huntingdon (2½m, good) 23 days ago. A stronger gallop here will see him to better effect and fully expected to play a lead role.

finals.race: Support The Injured Jockeys Fund Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Fair placed form in maiden/novice hurdles last winter. Hasn't gone on over fences more recently, off the bridle before most when well held at Newcastle (2½m) last time. Hard to be confident back up in trip on return to hurdling.

finals.race: Join Ladbrokes Bet 5 Pound Get 30 Pound Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Has a good record in smaller fields and returned from a 5-month break to win a 4-runner event at Market Rasen in September. Clear of the remainder when second of 5 in handicap chase at this course (19f, good to firm) 20 days ago and he can go well again having been nudged up another 1 lb.

finals.race: Happy 80th Birthday Pamela Hall Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Overcame some typically sketchy jumping when off the mark in change of headgear at Uttoxeter last month. Confirmed he's going the right way when well-backed second in a 0-125 at Cheltenham last time. No surprise to see him go one better with Sean Bowen back aboard for first time since chasing bow.

finals.race: Happy 80th Birthday Pamela Hall Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Four-time hurdles winner. Jumped much better than usual when easily justifying support under Harry Cobden (1-1) at Uttoxeter (3m) in July. That form has worked out well, and he doesn't have much to find in his bid for a second chase success.

finals.race: Ascot Shared Ownership Weekend Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Badly hampered in last year's renewal before deservedly getting his head in front at Wincanton in March. Went with enthusiasm when 1½ lengths third in a stronger C&D handicap latest. Weighted to confirm form with reopposing trio and may well give his 7-lb claimer a second win as a professional.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Dam won 3 times at the highest level, including the Irish Oaks, and showed plenty on debut when sixth of 13 in novice at Kempton 16 days ago, keeping on when denied a clear run over 1f out. Will be suited by further, but could still be in the mix with improvement to come.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Bred in the purple and showed plenty of promise on debut when fourth of 7 in a Newmarket novice (1m) in September. Still seemed green when second of 5 in maiden at Yarmouth (7f) only 16 days later, so she remains capable of better for her leading yard.

finals.race: BAR 1 Betting 'Safer Gambling Week' Rated Race
finals.comment: A fairly useful 7f winner in the UAE for Michael Costa. Changed hands for £100,000 but made a discouraging start for these connections when last of 17 in handicap (66/1) at the Curragh (7f, good to firm) on debut. Might be better suited by return to all-weather, at least.

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
finals.comment: Ten Sovereigns colt wasn't given a hard time but shaped quite well amidst obvious greenness when fifth of 8 in maiden at Leopardstown (1m, good to firm, 100/1) on debut in August. Absent since but should still improve.

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
finals.comment: Foaled April 14. Nando Parrado gelding. Half-brother to 1m winner Banner Beauty. Dam unraced half-sister to smart winner up to 8.2f Playa Del Puente. Yard 1-12 with 2-y-o newcomers this season.

finals.race: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap
finals.comment: Cemented positive start made for Ollie Sangster when ending losing run over this C&D in July. Hasn't been in the same form in 3 starts for present stable this autumn, so needs to get back on track returned to this venue (cheekpieces tried last time discarded).

dropped.comment: Modest maiden on the Flat didn't achieve very much on hurdles debut at Sedgefield earlier in the month. Wears first-time hood.
